arguments.name: release
arguments.description: Release package ZIP archive to analyse.

arguments.name: docker_repository
arguments.description: Docker repository compared with the release to work out which images need building.

arguments.name: yaml_repository
arguments.description: YAML repository holding the target OpenShift resources and its .entropy/resource_index.json.

arguments.name: image_tag
arguments.description: Image tag the release images are built and deployed with.

arguments.name: structure
arguments.description: Release structure definition YAML; the plugin's bundled structure.yaml is used when omitted.

arguments.name: image_transfer_script
arguments.description: Image transfer script inside the release; its 'docker push' images update matching Deployments.

outputs.name: release
outputs.description: Release package details: package, root, docker_source_release and docker_dest_repo.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: Images that need building, keyed by image name.

outputs.name: deployment
outputs.description: Planned OpenShift changes: required flag, resources by type and operations (create, apply, replace).

outputs.name: common_paths
outputs.description: Common path rsync operations found in the release.

outputs.name: database
outputs.description: Database scripts found in the release: dir, scripts and execution_plan.
